newsitem.title: USA: Nine West says under SEC investigation.
newsitem.headline: Nine West says under SEC investigation.

text.p: Nine West Group said Tuesday that the Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating, among other things, its revenue recognition policies and practices.
In an amended annual report filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Nine West said it is cooperating with the SEC in its "formal order of investigation."
In the filing, Nine West said the SEC had entered a formal order of investigation into the company on April 10.
The Stamford, Ct., based company said it had been cooperating fully with the regulatory agency when the investigation was informal.
Nine West said it does not anticipate the investigation will have any material adverse financial effect on the company.
Nine West is a designer, developer and marketer of women's footwear.
